name: XGS-Hermes-Research-Intelligence-2026-08-26
observations: Public RO optimizes for judging whether claims are trustworthy and reusable; use a hierarchical claim graph with evidence, conditions, limitations, version, and visible supported/partial/disputed/missing states.

LLM OCR is an automatic platform processing capability without per-document prompts; route through AI Gateway with minimal-page selection, provenance, audit, and no promotion of generated text to original evidence.

Pure-CPU infrastructure: use layered native parsing plus Docling or LiteParse evaluation, GROBID, Tesseract or PaddleOCR fallback, and local BGE-M3-style hybrid retrieval; no local GPU generation stack.
MiniMax image/video is admin-only for representative presentation drafts; deterministic SVG, Mermaid, Plotly, and HTML may be broadly available. Presentation media is never evidence.
Core database and search storage are separated by DATABASE_URL and SEARCH_DATABASE_URL so chunks and embeddings can migrate independently; binaries remain in object storage.

Institutional PDFs are temporary platform cache with 72-hour TTL; downloadable by 10-minute signed link only when rights allow, otherwise provide the source link. Preserve hashes, metadata, and evidence references.
Capability retention requires measured quality, source-locator accuracy, latency, cost, CPU/memory, failure modes, security, and rollback evidence; all installs are project-scoped and recorded.
